item.theboys.compound_v.desc: Vought serum. Randomly grants the powers of A-Train or Billy Butcher.
item.theboys.compound_v1.desc: The very first Compound V. Extremely rare. Grants the powers of Homelander or Soldier Boy.
item.theboys.uranium_injector.desc: Radiation burns the V out of your blood - your power is gone.
item.theboys.syringe.how: Hold the syringe and press [V] (or hold right click)
item.theboys.soldier_boy_shield.desc: Vought alloy. As Soldier Boy you can throw it [C].
message.theboys.no_power: You have no power. Find a Vought lab and take Compound V.
message.theboys.burned_out: Soldier Boy's radiation burned the V out of your blood - your power is gone!
message.theboys.need_shield: You need Soldier Boy's shield in your hand.
message.theboys.rewind_busy: Time is already running backwards here.
message.theboys.nothing_to_remove: You have no power to remove.
message.theboys.already_powered: You already have a power. Remove it with a Uranium Injector first.
message.theboys.got_power: The V kicks in... you have the powers of %s!
message.theboys.keys_hint: Abilities: [R] [G] [C] [X] · Suit: [J] (change in Controls -> The Boys)
message.theboys.power_removed: The radiation burned the V out of your body. You are human again.
message.theboys.super_cancer: SUPER CANCER! The tendrils take over...
message.theboys.cancer_walk_on: Cancer Walk - the tendrils carry you
item.theboys.mini_v.desc: Pink serum. Turns you into MiniMaus.
message.theboys.moon_ready: To the Moon ready - hit something!
message.theboys.small_on: You are tiny! Left click nibbles single pixels out of blocks.
